instruction: Cinematic action still, full shot. Inside a misty MMA gym with metal rigs, a sparring session is underway. On the left, the shirtless man in black shorts (R1) stands with his back partially turned, raising his black gloves to block. On the right, the bearded shirtless man in patterned leggings (R3) balances on one leg, executing a high roundhouse kick with his right leg aimed at the opponent's head. The bearded shirtless man looks intently at his target. Cool overhead spotlights illuminate the scene, casting dramatic shadows through the thick white smoke in the background.
